item.text: [{"task_id":"694f12f3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    source = int(round(params['settings'][0]))","    small = int(round(params['settings'][1]))","    large = int(round(params['settings'][2]))","    border = int(round(params['settings'][3]))","    lower = int(round(params['settings'][4]))","    directions = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['directions']]","    height, width = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    seen = set()","    objects = []","    for position in np.argwhere(grid == source):","        start = (int(position[0]), int(position[1]))","        if start in seen:","            continue","        seen.add(start)","        cells = [start]","        for row, col in cells:","            for dr, dc in directions:","                nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc","                if lower <= nr < height and lower <= nc < width:","                    neighbor = (nr, nc)","                    if neighbor not in seen and grid[nr, nc] == source:","                        seen.add(neighbor)","                        cells.append(neighbor)","        objects.append(cells)","    if not objects:","        return out","    largest = max(len(cells) for cells in objects)","    for cells in objects:","        top = min(row for row, col in cells)","        bottom = max(row for row, col in cells)","        left = min(col for row, col in cells)","        right = max(col for row, col in cells)","        color = large if len(cells) == largest else small","        for row, col in cells:","            if top + border <= row <= bottom - border and left + border <= col <= right - border:","                out[row, col] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"settings":[5],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"settings":[4,1,2,1,0],"directions":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Identify connected yellow rectangles and preserve their one-cell borders. Recolor the interior of the larger rectangle red and the smaller rectangle blue, comparing their areas."}]
